headline: Why Nigeria's ntel is pivoting from telecom operator to infrastructure company

story_facts.headline: Why Nigeria's ntel is pivoting from telecom operator to infrastructure company
story_facts.plain_language_summary: ntel said on Monday, during its relaunch, that it is transitioning into a digital infrastructure company, focusing on towers, fibre networks, power systems and real estate
